theorems.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ ρ Ψ : Rn n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ρ ∧ ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) Ψ ∧ (∀ z : Rn n, 1 ≤ ‖z‖ → ρ z = 0) ∧ (∀ z : Rn n, 1 ≤ ‖z‖ → Ψ z = 0) ∧ (∀ z : Rn n, ρ (-z) = ρ z) ∧ ∫ z, ρ z = 1 ∧ ∀ z v : Rn n, fderiv ℝ Ψ z v = ρ z * inner ℝ z v
